paragraphs: Providing compassionate, family‑focused dental care in Concord, NC — from routine cleanings to advanced treatments — to keep your smile healthy and confident.
Our experienced team of dental professionals is committed to providing exceptional care with the highest standards of clinical excellence and patient comfort.
Comprehensive dental care for every member of your family. From routine cleanings to advanced treatments, we provide exceptional care with the latest technology and techniques.
Our experienced team of dental professionals is committed to providing exceptional care with the highest standards of clinical excellence and patient comfort.

Riccobene Family Dentistry’s Concord, NC location is conveniently located northeast of Charlotte off of Concord Parkway and Pitts School Rd. Come see what happens when family dentistry with 25 years of expert experience is paired with our modern, welcoming staff.

We’re part of your local Concord community and we’ve designed our office and services to reflect the fact that we’re not just serving customers, we’re helping our friends and family smile just a little bit easier. The Riccobene Way is how we describe our philosophy - that family dentistry should be compassionate, caring and comprehensive.
We believe in the Riccobene Way - a commitment to deliver better dentistry, better experiences and better results with a comprehensive and compassionate approach.
When you help a lot of people you get to some large numbers that we’re proud of - each satisfied patient is another happy smile.
Can't make it to our Concord office? We have other convenient locations in the area to serve you with the same exceptional dental care.
Quality dental care should be accessible to everyone. We offer flexible payment options, accept most insurance plans, and provide affordable membership plans for uninsured patients.
Save money on dental care with our affordable annual membership plans. No insurance? No problem! Get the care you need at a price you can afford.

Yes, emergency dental services are offered at our Concord, NC location. We do our best to accommodate same and next-day appointments when emergencies arise, and if what you need can’t be addressed at our Concord location we have seven other locations in the Charlotte area that may be able to help.

We evaluate each case individually to confirm whether the services you require can be performed in-office. We do offer dental implants at our Concord location, and refer to other facilities if more complicated dental surgery is required.
Yes, we are accepting new patients at the Riccobene Family Dentistry location in Concord, NC!
Yes, we offer a variety of cosmetic dentistry procedures at our Concord, NC office including tooth whitening procedures, veneers, and Invisalign® treatment.

We accept and participate with a large majority of insurance plans. Prior to any treatment, our team will perform a complimentary benefits evaluation to let you know what your insurance covers. We also offer flexible payment options and an affordable dental membership plan for patients without insurance.
Give us a call at (704) 461-0707 to make an appointment or click below to book an appointment online.
Take the first step towards optimal oral health. Contact our Concord office to schedule your appointment or ask any questions about our dental services.
Fill out the form below and we'll get back to you within 24 hours.
Select a Location to schedule an appointment:
Call our Concord Office at 704-461-0707, or use the form below to request an appointment.

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS
Do you offer emergency dental services in Concord, NC?

Yes, emergency dental services are offered at our Concord, NC location. We do our best to accommodate same and next-day appointments when emergencies arise, and if what you need can’t be addressed at our Concord location we have seven other locations in the Charlotte area that may be able to help.

Does your Concord dental clinic provide dental implants?

We evaluate each case individually to confirm whether the services you require can be performed in-office. We do offer dental implants at our Concord location, and refer to other facilities if more complicated dental surgery is required.

Is Riccobene Associates in Concord accepting new patients?

Yes, we are accepting new patients at the Riccobene Family Dentistry location in Concord, NC!

Do you offer cosmetic dentistry at your Concord, NC office?

Yes, we offer a variety of cosmetic dentistry procedures at our Concord, NC office including tooth whitening procedures, veneers, and Invisalign® treatment.

What insurance plans are accepted at your Concord dental office?

We accept and participate with a large majority of insurance plans. Prior to any treatment, our team will perform a complimentary benefits evaluation to let you know what your insurance covers. We also offer flexible payment options and an affordable dental membership plan for patients without insurance.

How can I schedule an appointment at your Concord, NC, office?

Give us a call at (704) 461-0707 to make an appointment or click below to book an appointment online.
